parsed.strategy: Bet on liquid global quality-momentum: names with strong 6-12 month momentum (mom_252_21) plus improving or stable gross margins, concentrated in AI semis/memory (MU, SNDK, AMD, NVDA, TSM, ASML, TER), GLP-1 and bioprocessing platforms (LLY, WST, RGEN, ABBV, AMGN), and high-revision software (CRWD, PANW, SNOW, OKTA), with AME as the robotics-adjacent industrial. Every name carries positive 90-day revision flow and sits near or above its 200-day. I would be wrong if a hyperscaler capex digestion headline or a memory pricing rollover hits the semis sleeve simultaneously, or if the software revision clusters unwind on a single weak guide.
parsed.objective: Maximize relative P&L versus the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 with a long-only quality-momentum book.
